summary: The PR addresses the inconsistency in the behavior of `makemigrations --check` by ensuring it exits without writing migrations, aligning with other commands like `migrate --check`. The change is minimal and appears correct based on the provided context.

issues.description: The help text update could be improved for clarity, e.g., specifying that `--check` will not generate migration files.
The reordering of the `sys.exit(1)` call might slightly affect readability, as it moves the check after the migration file writing logic.
